text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Its main goal is text understanding, which means breaking down sentences to grasp their meaning, not just the individual words. This technology powers many everyday tools. For example, online translation services can instantly convert text from English to Spanish or Japanese. Another important use is sentiment analysis, which allows companies to detect whether customer reviews are positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, NLP is behind modern chatbots, which can hold conversations with users to answer questions or provide support. From simple spell-checkers to virtual assistants, NLP is quietly changing how we interact with machines every day.
